sound: Exterior deck machinery bed
detail: A deck bed exists. Add localized vents, distant machinery and occasional hull settling; vary with carrier load and listener location.

sound: Bridge and corridor ventilation
detail: interior_ventilation.ogg already blends room hum and fan. Add distinct bridge, corridor and enclosed-room profiles.

sound: Hangar, vehicle bay and machinery-room ambience
detail: Use localized fans, electrical transformers, pumps and metal room reflections. Fade at openings instead of one constant everywhere.

sound: Exposed deck wind and sheltered transitions
detail: Wind already exists in flight/weather and commander mixes. Add dedicated open-deck wind driven by relative wind, height and shelter.

sound: Hull creaks, loose panels and structural settling
detail: Sparse one-shots while turning, braking and crossing rough ground; avoid a repeating creak loop.

sound: Track-link rolling and clatter
detail: track_links.ogg follows each tread. Review in-game audibility first; add load/terrain texture and different left/right speed response.

sound: Track engagement, braking and skid turns
detail: Add start clunk, stop settling, tension squeak and hard-turn scrub. A moving loop alone does not communicate these transitions.

sound: Carrier electric drive under load
detail: Generic deck bed exists; create a distinct load-sensitive electrical drive layer underneath track clatter.

sound: Deck elevator motor travel
detail: elevator_moving_mono.wav is wired. Current RuntimeAudio fills a zero-length loop range and elevator update restarts stopped playback. Historical silence is not proof of a current failure.

sound: Island passenger lift motor
detail: Currently shares the deck-elevator source. Give the smaller lift its own travel, braking and cabin perspective.

sound: Elevator locking pins, release and arrival thump
detail: Distinct unlock before travel, brake deceleration, then locking clunk only after actual stop/alignment. Different up/down arrivals may need different resonance.

sound: Elevator covers: lift, slide, close and latch
detail: Cover movement already raises the shared motor layer. Add separate sliding weight and closing/latch transients.

sound: Personnel doors: actuator and sealing latch
detail: door_slide.wav plays on movement/reversal; add final contact/seal only if useful, plus distinct heavy bay-door character.

sound: Catapult engagement, charging, release and reset
detail: Latch aircraft, tension/charge, launch stroke, release and shuttle return are separate events. Keep launch sound synchronized with the actual shared launch gate.

sound: Landing catch/arrest and release
detail: A catch transient, deceleration tension and final release should identify successful recovery. Tie to actual catch state rather than nearby flight.

sound: Recovery robots: drive, arms, clamps and towing
detail: Electric locomotion, arm servo, wheel clamp, tow strain and clamp release. Stop each layer when that mechanism stops.

sound: Wing fold/unfold and lock
detail: Actuator while moving, endpoint latch, and optional obstruction/stall cue. Respect each authored aircraft mechanism.

sound: Rearming, repair and charging services
detail: Short tool, connector and completion cues where service events are visible; do not create invisible ongoing workshop noise for abstract timers.

sound: Distinct electric motor identities
detail: Eight numbered fixed-wing scenes use airplane_propeller 3.wav; two use airplane_propeller 1.wav. Add separate electrical tone plus aerodynamic layer with per-aircraft profiles.

sound: Motor start, contactor, acceleration and shutdown
detail: Startup assets are assigned; EngineSoundStop hook exists but no assignment was found in numbered aircraft scenes. Add contactor click, spool-up, load changes and coast-down.

sound: Propeller whirr and blade beating
detail: Provide low/medium/high rotational beds plus blade-load pulse; vary with actual rotation/load and prop layout, not only a pitch shift of one motor loop.

sound: Helicopter rotor identity, spool and loaded beating
detail: Aircraft 9–13 and 15 share Helicopter3 slow/medium/fast exterior layers. Add distinct light/utility/heavy rotor balance and spool tails.

sound: Exterior fly-by and distance perspective
detail: 3D attenuation exists. Review Doppler/distance treatment and directional prop/rotor balance before adding prerecorded fly-bys that could double the engine.

sound: Electrical systems and ventilation
detail: cabin_systems.ogg and per-scene cockpit interiors exist. Distinguish quiet modern, rough older, and exposed-canopy cockpits without masking radio.

sound: Airspeed rush, dirty-flight drag and stall buffet
detail: AirflowFeedback and ContinuousTurbulence already supply wind/rush/buffet. Check overlap and mix before adding another wind bed.

sound: Canopy open/close, latch and pressure seal
detail: Where canopy animation exists, tie actuator, latch and wind perspective to its actual position. Skip pressure hiss for unpressurized cabins.

sound: Control switches, throttle detents and seat/harness movement
detail: Quiet local interactions with restrained variation; trigger only on actions, not every frame of axis movement.

sound: Landing gear and flap operation
detail: Gear deployment/stow have recordings. Fixed-wing FlapSoundLoop assignments resolve to Resource placeholders; flap_loop.ogg has no literal hookup found. Verify and supply a real stream.

sound: Gear lock and touchdown confirmation
detail: Add physical lock clunks and wheel/suspension touchdown thumps; avoid a UI success jingle for every landing.

sound: Critical flight/system warnings
detail: Separate stall/overspeed/gear unsafe/power failure meanings where those states exist. Prioritize one urgent cue, with cooldowns and acknowledgement.

sound: Part tear-off, spar snap and skin crumple
detail: Layer a short fracture transient, metallic strain and loose fragments; size by damaged part and emit once per actual detachment.

sound: Control-surface or gear breakaway
detail: Small, sharp variants for aileron/gear versus heavy wing/tail separation. Preserve spatial location as debris separates.

sound: Motor damage, arcing and dying bearings
detail: Damage-driven irregular whine/grind and electrical crackle; sound follows disabled/reduced-power state and stops on destruction.

sound: Loose panel flutter and structural stress
detail: Airflow-dependent rattle for a damaged section; separate from healthy stall buffet. Avoid implying imminent failure unless the state supports it.

sound: Canopy hits and cracking
detail: Bullet metal/dirt impacts exist; dedicated glass/canopy and cockpit transmission variants would make hit location clearer.

sound: Normal wheel touchdown, roll and brakes
detail: Contact thump, rolling texture and short brake chirp with speed/surface scaling; separate from gear deployment.

sound: Belly slide on dirt, gravel, rock and deck
detail: Initial impact + sustained friction + bumps/debris + settling. Use relative contact speed and surface; fade when airborne or stopped.

sound: Wingtip/propeller ground strike and cartwheel impacts
detail: Distinct short strikes with contact-episode cooldown, separate from sustained fuselage scrape; broken prop must no longer sound healthy.

sound: Detached debris bouncing and settling
detail: Bounded impact pool by material and mass; only the most audible nearby collisions, then silence at rest.

sound: Canopy jettison, ejection seat and parachute
detail: Staged release, seat launch, wind transition, chute opening and cloth flutter; no engine interior hum after ejection.

sound: Pilot landing, walking and rescue pickup
detail: Officer metal footsteps exist. Add appropriate ground/cloth sounds and a quiet rescue/boarding confirmation where animated.

sound: Electric drivetrains by vehicle weight
detail: Scout, armored carrier and harvester need start/load/coast/stop identity; current turret/weapon audio does not cover locomotion.

sound: Tires, suspension, gravel and body rattle
detail: Drive surface texture, corner scrub, rough-ground suspension and limited cabin rattles. Do not use carrier treads for wheeled vehicles.

sound: Vehicle bay loading ramp, restraint and doors
detail: Motorized bay opening, ramp settling and release/load locks synced to deployment and recovery.

sound: Harvester arm deploy, extraction and retraction
detail: Servo articulation, sustained extraction/pump/grind, change of load and stow latch; distinguish corium extraction from plasteel salvage.

sound: Cargo transfer, salvage pickup and unloading
detail: Mechanical handling at world pickup and carrier return; a quiet receipt cue when resources actually arrive.

sound: Replicator assembly cycle
detail: ReplicatorChamber currently loops electrical_hum_2.wav. Add start, arm/tool activity, assembly phase change, completion and shutdown.

sound: Machine guns and cannon families
detail: Multiple shot banks already exist. Review caliber distinction, near/far tails and rates; prioritize missing actions before buying more gunshots.

sound: Reload, weapon mechanism, dry fire and jam
detail: Only use reload/jam cues for states actually represented. Mechanical recoil/feeding can complement existing shot banks.

sound: Rocket launch, bomb release and ordnance flight
detail: rocket.wav is wired. Add rack release/door action and appropriate near-pass/flight cues where supported.

sound: Impacts, ricochets and incoming near misses
detail: Metal/dirt impact banks exist. Add concrete/glass distinctions and sparse bullet crack/whizz feedback for nearby threats.

sound: Explosions, debris tails and burning wrecks
detail: Large explosion variants exist. Add restrained sustained wreck fire/electrical failure and mass-dependent debris tails.

sound: Turret rotation and end stops
detail: electric_servo.ogg follows turret motion. Differentiate heavy carrier mounts and small remote mounts; avoid spurious endpoint knocks.

sound: Storm wind and sand on canopy
detail: Dust-front wind, twister roar and synthetic canopy ticks/rattle exist. Add deck/body grit only where exposed; keep cockpit-only grains contained.

sound: Electrical storm strike, crack and distant thunder
detail: Strike-local crack, low rolling tail and distance delay tied to the visible event; actual discharge need not always sound like ordinary rain thunder.

sound: Wind turbines, outpost machinery and ruin creaks
detail: Localized rotor/transformer beds at active structures; wind openings and sparse metal movement at abandoned sites.

sound: Subtle biome and wildlife ambience
detail: Sparse fauna/insects and distant environment appropriate to the authored biome; avoid generic birds everywhere.

sound: Corium seep and salvage-site details
detail: Quiet bubbling/venting for visible corium and loose-metal sounds while interacting with salvage; optional narrative ambience.

sound: Button click, order confirmation and cancellation
detail: Three quiet UI cues exist with throttling. Keep hover silent and retain restrained feedback.

sound: Contact, objective, damage and resource alerts
detail: Radio and UI feedback exist; use a small consistent cue vocabulary for new actionable information, with priority/stack limits.

sound: Radio squelch, static and distance degradation
detail: Voice queues, procedural static and Radio-bus effects already exist. Preserve intelligibility; new chatter should not block urgent calls.

sound: Target acquired / lost / weapon ready
detail: Assign distinct tones only to existing meaningful targeting transitions; no constant beeping for ordinary selection changes.
